evidence.note: Thorough up-front environment probing: checks OS (os-release), runtimes (python3/python/node/go/rustc/cargo), package managers (apt/pip3/npm), node version, contents of /app and /app/data, and whether start.sh already exists, then installs aiohttp/aiosqlite/python-multipart. Confirms the runtime before building — matches the 5 anchor's 'confirms the runtime.'

Builds handlers spanning every subsystem (auth, users, workspaces, channels, messages, threads, reactions, pins, DMs, files, search, read state, groups, invitations, WS, IRC) — evidence it extracted the main per-subsystem contracts, but straight from a top-down read rather than a written contract inventory.

Test script encodes specific contract points (409 on duplicate register/workspace, 404 on remove-reaction of non-existent message, read_state 400), showing explicit status codes/envelope keys were mined. This is contract-checking at the 'most explicit codes' level of anchor 5.

Late check of SPA data-testid coverage against the pinned list (notes channel-settings-close, channel-entry, message, emoji-option, member-row missing) — confirms it referenced the testid contract, but only reactively near the end.

Touches seq semantics (get_next_seq) and node_id indexing (NODE_ID=0 for port 8000) in passing, but never surfaces the subtle traps anchor 8 demands: member_user_ids vs members, transfer_ownership vs PATCH-to-owner, guest/member channel gates, non-member mention exclusion, resume.gap, dense-seq-across-writers. No living/revisited contract map.

reasoning: The agent did genuine, well-targeted environment probing before building (runtimes, package managers, ports, dependencies) and extracted the main contracts for every subsystem, catching most explicit status codes, envelope keys, and the data-testid list — squarely the level-5 description. It does not reach 8: there is no systematic distilled contract inventory, the subtle traps (member_user_ids naming, transfer_ownership vs PATCH, guest/admin gating, non-member mention exclusion, resume.gap, dense-seq-across-writers) are never surfaced or reasoned about, and much contract-checking happened reactively via the test script rather than as proactive research steering implementation.
